command: set -o pipefail; echo '===IDENTITY==='; whoami; hostname; date -Is; echo '===HOME TOP==='; find ~ -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*free*frank*' -o -iname '*frank*terminal*' -o -iname '*crush*' -o -name '*.desktop' \) 2>/dev/null | sort | head -250; echo '===SERVICES==='; systemctl --user --no-pager --type=service --all 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'frank|crush|clay|bridge|stern' || true; echo '===PROCS==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,cmd | grep -Ei 'free.?frank|frank_terminal|stern.py|crush|chatgpt' | grep -v grep || true; echo '===LIKELY DIRS==='; for d in ~/frankenstein-repo ~/frankenstein-2.0 ~/frank-repo ~/.claude/star ~/FreeFrank ~/free-frank ~/free_frank; do [ -e "$d" ] && { echo ---$d; find "$d" -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | head -120; }; done; echo '===DESKTOP ENTRIES==='; for f in ~/.local/share/applications/*.desktop ~/Desktop/*.desktop; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo ---$f; sed -n '1,200p' "$f"; }; done; echo '===ENV==='; env | grep -Ei 'FRANK|CRUSH|CHATGPT|BRIDGE|GROQ|NVIDIA' | sed -E 's/(TOKEN|KEY|SECRET|PASSWORD)=.*/\1=<redacted>/I' | sort || true
